english.title: Club worker knowingly allow supply of alcohol to members order to person under 18 - Licensing
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person who worked in a capacity whether paid or unpaid, on relevant premises, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PREMISES AND LOCATION..), knowingly allowed the supply of alcohol on those premises by or on behalf of the club, to or to the order of a member of the club, to a person under the age of 18, namely **(..SPECIFY THE AGE..), when you were authorised to prevent it
english.legislation: Contrary to section 147(3)(b),(4)(a) and (5) of the Licensing Act 2003.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
12 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
